<div class="card-body">
'''Death Star Trooper''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">デス・スター兵員</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">デス・スターにのみ配備する。その他の星系へ移動することはできる。デス・スター以外の位置では、戦闘力－１となる。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Death-Star-Trooper-video.png|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Death Star Trooper (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Death-Star-Trooper-C1G.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">戦術にも武器の扱いにも秀でたエリート兵士である。兵員の１人、デヴィン・キャントは、監房ブロックＡＡ－２３に、レイア姫の看守として派遣されていた。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Star Trooper.

'''Card text:''' Deploy only on the Death Star. May move to other systems. Power −1 at locations other than the Death Star.

'''Lore:''' Elite soldiers skilled in tactics and weapons. One of them, Devin Cant, was assigned as a guard for Princess Leia in Detention Block AA-23.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese specifies movement to other systems and applies the power reduction at locations other than the Death Star. The English permits movement elsewhere and specifies a site other than a Death Star site.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star Trooper]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
